notes.title: 'Orbs Orbs Orbs' Out NOW!
notes.notes: [p]I'm very happy to announce that the this bright precision clicker game is available to buy now! Go and enjoy the colourful bouncing orbs and please ensure to leave a Steam review. It really helps small indie game developers like me. [/p][p][/p][p]Many thanks for the support along the way.[/p]

notes.title: We've Gone Gold! Orbs Orbs Orbs Launches Soon!
notes.notes:
[p][b]🎉 It’s Official: We’ve Gone Gold![/b]
Orbs Orbs Orbs is complete and submitted for launch right after the upcoming Steam Fest! I'm very excited to finally share this chaotic, relaxing precision clicker with you.[/p][p]🟢 55 handcrafted levels
🟣 6 unique orb types with their own physics
🧠 Puzzling mechanics like red zones, destructible blocks, and gravity trickery
💥 And now... [b]11 Steam achievements[/b] to test your strategy and mastery![/p][p]Whether you’re after chilled-out clicking or 3-orb perfection on every level, Orbs Orbs Orbs is designed to challenge and charm you in equal measure.[/p][p]Thanks for all the support so far![/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.5 Now Live
notes.notes: The Start button now plays the most recently unlocked level and the highest Star rating is saved instead of the most recent Star Rating on the Level Select. 4K resolution has also been disabled until a solution can be found for the visual bugs.

notes.title: Simplified Scoring: Focus on the Orbs
notes.notes:
I've heard your feedback! Players wanted a clearer understanding of what success looks like in Orbs Orbs Orbs, so I've streamlined the end screen.

Gone are the extra stuff—no more time, score, or personal bests. Now, the 3 Orb rating is the single, shining indicator of how well you’ve performed. This makes it easier to focus on improving your play and understanding your progress in each level.

More clarity, less clutter. Let the Orbs guide you.

notes.title: Anti Flicker Accessibility Option Added to Orbs Orbs Orbs
notes.notes: I've added an anti flicker feature in the options for Orbs Orbs Orbs. In the options menu you can now select Anti Flicker and it will stop the orbs from dazzling the player by adding a plain grey background. This way anyone who suffers from bright flickering lights can still enjoy Orbs Orbs Orbs.

notes.title: Recorded Demo Playthrough
notes.notes: I'm Chris, the developer of Orbs Orbs Orbs and I'll be uploading a video of me playing the demo. I talk about the features of the game to give you an understanding of it before you play.

notes.title: 🟣 NEW TRACK BY STUDIO CHIMP 🟣
notes.notes:
Hey Orb-hunters!

I'm thrilled to announce that Studio Chimp (Matthew Parisi) has returned with a brand-new original track for Orbs Orbs Orbs. This new tune cranks the synth energy up a notch.

If you loved the original track, you’re in for a treat. This track is woven straight into the game and will appear at the start of the game. 

🎧 Listen for it next time you dive in — or just crank the volume and vibe.

More audio surprises may be on the way soon… 👀

Cheers!

Chris,

notes.title: Progress Update – Build Working on Steam!
notes.notes:
Quick update on Orbs Orbs Orbs! A build is now up and running on Steam, which is a pretty big step forward. However, I’ll need to wait about three weeks before I can get keys to you in order to showcase and test the game.

In the meantime, I’ll be polishing things up and making sure everything runs smoothly. Thanks for your patience—I can’t wait to share more with you soon!

Be sure to check out me making the game on Twitch here: https://www.twitch.tv/acrylic_pixel

Stay tuned!

Chris 

Acrylic Pixel Games
